Anjali Patel: Quick sync — cutover window today 17:00 PT. We need version bump, changelog scrub, and QA sign-off by 15:30. @Sam Kim @Leo Park who’s on final merge?
Sam Kim: I'm on merge duty for backend. Will bump to v0.23.2 and open the PR now.
Michelle Nguyen: I’ll scrub changelog + release notes. Ping me once the PR is up. ETA 15:00.
Leo Park: I’ll handle branch fanout + watches. Reminder: no feature merges after cutoff. I’ll run smoke tests after canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started — canary-2026-03-17. Health checks: 3/3 OK.
Eve (QA): Planning smoke sweep at 15:40. Please include the build number in the PR title so I can correlate. I’ll sign off if green.
Anjali Patel: Security review request — @Sanjay (Security) can you confirm CVE/snyk checks are ✅? We ran a scan earlier but need final thumbs.
Sanjay (Security): Snyk scan returning no criticals. One medium in a dev-dep (tracked in #eng-security-issues). Not blocking for this release.
Sam Kim: PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/pull/1234 — bumped to v0.23.2, changelog diff included. Build: 2026.0317.1
Michelle Nguyen: LGTM for changelog. Tiny wording nit in release notes, I pushed a minor edit to the PR branch.
Leo Park: Branch fanout done — rebased release branches and propagated hotfixes. Commands I ran: `git checkout release/v0.23 && git pull && git merge --no-ff release-candidates && git push origin release/v0.23`
Eve (QA): Smoke sweep results: all endpoints OK, perf within SLO. Tests: auth, streaming, embeddings all pass. QA signing off ✅
Anjali Patel: All sign-offs collected — security, QA, docs. Cutting tag + starting full rollout at 17:00 PT. Thanks everyone :tada:
Sam Kim: Tagging and release notes publishing now. Will post the final link once cutover completes.
deploy-bot: Full rollout started — release-v0.23.2. Monitoring enabled.
